p: Parroquia San Pedro Apóstol de Tláhuac
C. Severino Ceniceros S/N, Centro de Tlahuac

Historic church built by Franciscan missionaries in 1529 on top of an ancient indigenous ceremonial center. The church incorporates rings from the old Mesoamerican ballcourt, near the cemetery entrance and in the atrium. The main church…

Small regional museum that tells tales of Tlahuac's past, from the different indigenous groups that inhabited the seven towns through the modern day. Includes quite a few relics and historical objects including a number of carved stones.
Collection of historical displays including archaeological relics as well as objects used in everyday life across different periods of the community's long history.
Casual sidewalk cafe serving tacos and mutton barbacoa as well as carnitas and other roasted and grilled meats.
